consumer.decision: May consume official FACTUAL analysis facts. Extra-cli never emits INDEX. DATA_READY is not permission to index. Consumer owns any editorial INDEX / SEO / CTA decision. Must not treat UNKNOWN as zero. Must not infer right, imbalance, loss or that an adjustment is due.

wedge.label: Fan-in of candidate score, evidence pack and comparable contracts into a consumer-bound FACTUAL pack
wedge.reuse: Adapters bind existing producer families; this projection does not rescore, rebuild evidence or recompute peers

data_state.owner: extra-cli emits only DATA_*; editorial INDEX is owned by the consumer

as_of: source_as_of from the evidence pack; never wall-clock

freshness.generated_at: declared export timestamp from the input payload; never wall-clock
freshness.stale_rule: generated_at minus source_as_of exceeds max_age_hours, or source_as_of is unparseable
invalidation_triggers: canonical contract identity, value or dates change after the evidence pack source_as_of
document set of the evidence pack changes after source_as_of
producer score, evidence pack or peer-group hash/version changes
freshness.invalidation_scope: only affected analysis_candidate_id payloads; previous hashed payload retained under analyses/previous/
freshness.refresh: re-run python3 -m scripts.public_read export-contract-analysis; no new scheduler

value_semantics.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN; absence of evidence is never zero

catalog_mode.fixture: labeled fixture; never consumed or labeled as live
catalog_mode.official_live: only when producers are live official artifacts and claimed_live is true

branding: truth plane and export are source-agnostic; brand marks and internal repo jargon are forbidden in public consumer fields
